_why: Founder 2026-10-01: 'we need some variety in the clips like older friends, older couple, group of friends, solo travellers, pilgrimage... doesnt only talk about nov dec... just do a round robin and use all angles before repetition so everyday there is new stuff'. Every reel spec carries one of these angle ids; scenario_daily.publish posts the ready reel whose angle was used longest ago, so no angle repeats until every other angle has had a day. Facts come from scripts/reel-fact-pack.mjs (one JSON per destination); script_gate checks each claim against that pack.
_narrator: One ElevenLabs voice narrates every reel, so the narrator is always a man telling what happened: the son, the brother, the father, one of the friends. The women, parents and children are on screen, never in close-up, no one looks at the camera.

month.name: Right place, wrong month
month.shape: They had a month fixed; the verdict or the crowd month moved it; the same place, a better month.

parents.name: Taking the parents
parents.cast: a son in his 30s and his parents in their 60s
parents.shape: The family wanted one place for the parents' trip; the elderly verdict said no or said be careful; a place that suits them, or the way to do the first one safely.

friends_swap.name: The famous place or the swap
friends_swap.cast: four friends, late 20s, two men and two women
friends_swap.shape: The group is set on the famous place; one friend finds the swap; the honest catch about who the swap is not for.

eatery.name: The meal worth the detour
eatery.cast: two friends, a man and a woman, late 20s
eatery.shape: Twenty identical fronts, hungry and arguing; the one place with a reason, and its insider tip. The voice names the dish and the area; the eatery's name goes in the caption, and the footage never pretends to be its real interior.

pilgrimage.name: Yatra with family
pilgrimage.cast: a son in his 30s and his mother in her 60s
pilgrimage.shape: Mother wants the yatra; the son worries about the climb; the route facts (distance, hours, pony or palki or helicopter, the registration rule) make it possible. Temple exteriors and paths only; no deity, no sanctum, no crowd scenes.

solo_woman.name: Her first solo trip
solo_woman.cast: a woman in her late 20s travelling alone; her brother is the voice
solo_woman.shape: She booked alone; the family argued; the brother checked and read the score and the note out loud. Positive only: no dramatised danger, ever.

kids.name: With a small child
kids.cast: parents in their 30s with a child of 2 to 4
data: kids (rating, min_recommended_age, best_age_group, stroller_accessible, family_verdict, concerns)
kids.shape: Friends recommended a place; the kids verdict (age, pram, the one concern) sent them somewhere that works for a child that age.

hidden_gem.name: The place nobody posts
hidden_gem.cast: a man in his 30s travelling alone
hidden_gem.shape: The famous place is packed; a short drive away is the place with no signboard; why nobody goes is the point.

friends_cost.name: Four friends, one budget
friends_cost.cast: four friends, late 20s, two men and two women
data: costs (hotel-mid per night, food per day, taxi per day, by season)
friends_cost.shape: The group budget versus the season's real prices; the month that makes the numbers work, said in words, exactly as the data has them.
